average_checkpoints_model_weights: average the model weights from multiple PyTorch checkpoint files into a single checkpoint
average_checkpoints_cli: run the CLI tool to average input checkpoint files and write the result to an output path
last_n_checkpoints_epoch: find the last N epoch-based checkpoint files in a directory matching checkpointXX.pt
last_n_checkpoints_update: find the last N update-based checkpoint files in a directory matching checkpoint_ee_XX.pt
average_best_checkpoints: average the N best checkpoint files sorted by their numeric suffix
